prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
**Top Tier Kitchens & Baths** looks like a strong option if your project is a kitchen or bathroom remodel. It serves Joplin, and the available listings show a 4.9 rating from 87 reviews on HomeAdvisor, along with positive customer comments about workmanship and communication. [HomeAdvisor](https://www.homeadvisor.com/tloc/Joplin-MO/Bathroom-Remodel/) · [Top Tier’s Joplin page](https://www.toptierkitchens.com/areas-served/joplin)

For broader remodeling or repair work, **Roof Master’s Remodeling Inc.** is another local candidate: BBB lists it as accredited with an A+ rating and says it handles interior renovation as well as roofing and other exterior work. Call **(417) 726-5226**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/roof-masters-remodeling-inc-0734-1000013706)

These are starting points, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and confirm who will handle permits and any subcontracted work.
